title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

reading.body:
Waymo autonomous vehicles became stranded on San Francisco streets during Fourth of July celebrations when traffic congestion prevented movement for extended periods and drained their batteries. At least a dozen vehicles, primarily Jaguar I-PACE models, were left stationary near the Golden Gate Bridge following a fireworks display. The deployment failed to handle a foreseeable real-world condition: major traffic events that create standstill conditions for hours and deplete battery reserves.

The system lacked a fallback for situations where traffic congestion would prevent normal operation. A human driver or dispatcher monitoring conditions could have rerouted vehicles away from the affected area or staged them to avoid the gridlock. The company attributed the stranding to unexpected road closures and high event traffic, though Fourth of July celebrations near the Golden Gate Bridge are annual and predictable events.

One vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks ignited on the street, though the autonomous system's role in this specific failure and whether injuries occurred are not established by the reporting.

reports.title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

summary:
# Summary

Multiple Waymo autonomous vehicles became stranded on San Francisco streets during Fourth of July celebrations when their batteries drained in severe traffic congestion. Video footage showed at least a dozen Waymo vehicles, primarily Jaguar I-PACE models, lined up stationary following a fireworks display near the Golden Gate Bridge. The company attributed the situation to major traffic disruptions, high volume of travelers, and unexpected road closures. Waymo's roadside assistance team worked to remove the vehicles, and the company stated it is evaluating ways to improve resilience during major traffic events.

During the incident, a Waymo vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks that someone had ignited on the street, though no injuries were reported. One passenger described the autonomous car continuing to drive despite fireworks exploding nearby. Frustrated motorists spent extended periods in standstill traffic, with some waiting nearly two hours. Mayor Daniel Lurie's office indicated it will discuss the traffic situation with stakeholders to ensure smoother experiences for future events.
